changes.comment: The name is drawn as the wordmark — "Oh Hi" on the highlighter, then "markdown" with its "mark" leaning — throughout the chrome, not only on the splash: the vault list's header and heading, the welcome heading (now the full name, in place of "Oh Hi."), the Settings header, Settings › About and the join page's brand line. The welcome's subline reads "A markdown editor for personal and collaborative notes."
